request: Add a read method to internal/charging that returns the stored monthly effective capacity for one vehicle and one exact month. The existing read picks the newest non-NULL row; this one must return the row for the month asked for, and report 'no row' distinctly from 'row with NULL capacity'. Honour RD4: the caller stores 0, so the port must let the caller tell the two cases apart. Tier 1 of 4 of roadmap RM67-vehicle-monthly-metrics-table (Linear MAG-73); it exists because tier 2 in analytics cannot copy the capacity without it.
